count_basis: Prospective logical posts per platform for 20 September. The desired four-post program is not a ready or active queue. Prepared and in-progress production counts remain unknown.
existing_phenomena_status: All eleven previously active 20-30 September entries were confirmed draft=true and autoPublish=false in the final live reads. Existing media is not deleted and is not permission to restore scheduling during the full queue reset.

remote_queue_audit.method: Three 20 September read windows initially confirmed all legacy standalone posts drafted. Subsequent live reads confirmed Blood Falls and every 21-30 September phenomenon also drafted. The earlier snapshot of 11 active phenomena is superseded. Draft cancellation is not permanent deletion of remote files or published posts.

hold_rule: Follow the latest master Notion migration status. Do not create, reactivate or reschedule anything while the full-reset hold is active. Do not treat withdrawn phenomenon entries as gaps to recover. The four daily categories remain the desired future program, not a claim that it is ready.
network_capacity_policy: Read current provider errors, rolling-24-hour attempts and cooldowns before any later authorized scheduling. No midnight reset assumption.
history_policy: Historical snapshots are retained in Git history only. queue/completed.json and state/content_history.json are unchanged.
